info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Weather Alerts Status-v1-spec
info.description: The Weather Alerts Status API provides real-time insights into the current status of weather alerts in a specified region. It enables users to access critical information regarding severe weather warnings, watches, and advisories issued by meteorological authorities. This API is essential for applications focused on safety, emergency preparedness, and weather monitoring, empowering users to stay informed about potentially hazardous conditions. Typical consumers include mobile weather applications, disaster management platforms, and alert notification services.

get.description: This endpoint allows clients to fetch the current status of alerts in the system. It provides insight into which alerts are active, resolved, or pending, thereby aiding in monitoring and management tasks.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the current status of alerts. Ensure that the request adheres to the expected schema to successfully fetch the information.

200.description: Request completed successfully and the status of alerts is returned.
